title: Interpretation of Scripture
definition: Interpretation of Scripture is the careful work of understanding what God's Word means according to its context, wording, genre, and place in the whole counsel of God.
summary: Faithful interpretation seeks the intended meaning of the text rather than forcing personal opinions into Scripture.
christFocus: Christ is the fulfillment of Scripture, so interpretation must honor both the immediate context and the Bible's redemptive witness to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Interpretation of Scripture teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to interpretation of scripture by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
